title.en: Oil Palm and the World's Fats

blurb.zh: 从西非雨林到全球第一大植物油：产量、贸易与为什么是油棕。
blurb.en: From West African forest to the world's leading vegetable oil: output, trade, and why palm won.
blurb.ms: Dari hutan Afrika Barat ke minyak sayuran utama dunia: pengeluaran, perdagangan, dan sebabnya.

blurb.zh: 棕榈的结构、花序与 dura／tenera／pisifera 三种果型的遗传。
blurb.en: How the palm is built, how it flowers, and the genetics behind dura, tenera and pisifera.
blurb.ms: Struktur pokok, pembungaan, dan genetik dura, tenera dan pisifera.

blurb.zh: 温度、雨量、水分亏缺与日照——决定一个地点能不能种。
blurb.en: Temperature, rainfall, water deficit and sunshine — what makes a site viable.
blurb.ms: Suhu, hujan, defisit air dan cahaya matahari — apa yang menentukan tapak.

blurb.zh: 什么样的土适合油棕，泥炭地的特殊问题，以及土地分级怎么读。
blurb.en: What oil palm needs from a soil, the peat problem, and how suitability classes work.
blurb.ms: Keperluan tanah, masalah tanah gambut, dan kelas kesesuaian.

blurb.zh: 干物质怎么分配、性比如何决定、从授粉到收成要多久。
blurb.en: How dry matter is partitioned, what sets the sex ratio, and the long road from flower to bunch.
blurb.ms: Pengagihan bahan kering, nisbah jantina, dan perjalanan dari bunga ke tandan.

blurb.zh: Deli dura × pisifera 的由来，遗传力，以及为什么一个育种周期要十几年。
blurb.en: Where Deli dura × pisifera came from, heritability, and why one cycle takes a decade or more.
blurb.ms: Asal usul Deli dura × pisifera, kebolehwarisan, dan kitaran sedekad.

blurb.zh: 无性系繁殖的承诺与 mantled 异常的教训，以及基因组学带来的改变。
blurb.en: The promise of clones, the lesson of the mantled abnormality, and what genomics changed.
blurb.ms: Janji klon, pengajaran keabnormalan mantled, dan kesan genomik.

blurb.zh: 催芽、预苗圃、大苗圃与淘汰——种苗质量决定往后二十五年。
blurb.en: Heat treatment, pre-nursery, main nursery and culling — 25 years ride on this stage.
blurb.ms: Rawatan haba, semaian awal, semaian utama dan pemilihan.

blurb.zh: 土地评估、园区规划、梯田与零燃烧整地。
blurb.en: Assessing land, laying out the estate, terracing, and clearing without fire.
blurb.ms: Menilai tanah, susun atur ladang, teres, dan pembersihan tanpa bakar.

blurb.zh: 三角形排列、每公顷多少株，以及密度对早期与后期产量的相反影响。
blurb.en: Triangular spacing, palms per hectare, and why density helps early yield and hurts later.
blurb.ms: Jarak segi tiga, pokok per hektar, dan kesan kepadatan.

blurb.zh: 覆盖作物、修叶、收割轮次、机械化、出油率与重种。
blurb.en: Covers, pruning, harvesting rounds, mechanisation, oil extraction rate and replanting.
blurb.ms: Tanaman penutup, pemangkasan, pusingan tuai, mekanisasi, OER dan tanam semula.

blurb.zh: 带走多少就要补多少：叶片分析、缺素症状、空果串与废水回收。
blurb.en: Replace what the crop removes: leaf analysis, deficiency symptoms, EFB and POME recycling.
blurb.ms: Gantikan apa yang diambil: analisis daun, simptom kekurangan, kitar semula EFB dan POME.

blurb.zh: Ganoderma 基腐病、镰刀菌枯萎、芽腐病、冠腐病与苗期病害。
blurb.en: Ganoderma basal stem rot, Fusarium wilt, bud rot, crown disease and nursery diseases.
blurb.ms: Reput pangkal batang Ganoderma, layu Fusarium, reput pucuk dan penyakit semaian.

blurb.zh: 袋蛾、刺蛾、犀角金龟、鼠害——以及那只让产量跳升的授粉象鼻虫。
blurb.en: Bagworms, nettle caterpillars, rhinoceros beetle, rats — and the weevil that lifted yields.
blurb.ms: Ulat bungkus, ulat bulu, kumbang badak, tikus — dan kumbang pendebunga.

blurb.zh: 从果串到毛棕油：榨油流程、脂肪酸组成、游离脂肪酸与分提。
blurb.en: Bunch to crude palm oil: the mill process, fatty acids, free fatty acid, and fractionation.
blurb.ms: Tandan ke minyak sawit mentah: proses kilang, asid lemak, FFA dan pemeringkatan.

blurb.zh: 谁在买、卖多少钱、用在哪里，以及棕油与人体健康的证据。
blurb.en: Who buys it, what it costs to make, where it ends up, and the evidence on health.
blurb.ms: Siapa membeli, kos pengeluaran, kegunaan, dan bukti kesihatan.

blurb.zh: 碳储量、泥炭地排放，以及气候变化反过来对油棕的影响。
blurb.en: Carbon stocks, peat emissions, and how a changing climate acts back on the crop.
blurb.ms: Stok karbon, pelepasan gambut, dan kesan iklim terhadap tanaman.

blurb.zh: 棕油生物柴油的能量平衡、碳偿还期与政策争议。
blurb.en: The energy balance of palm biodiesel, carbon payback time, and the policy argument.
blurb.ms: Imbangan tenaga biodiesel sawit, masa bayar balik karbon, dan polisi.

blurb.zh: 毁林、生物多样性、认证体系与小农的处境。
blurb.en: Deforestation, biodiversity, certification, and where smallholders stand.
blurb.ms: Penebangan hutan, biodiversiti, pensijilan, dan pekebun kecil.

blurb.zh: 需求增长、产量差距、育种目标——增产还是扩地？
blurb.en: Rising demand, the yield gap, breeding targets — more yield or more land?
blurb.ms: Permintaan meningkat, jurang hasil, sasaran pembiakbakaan.
